steps.title: Analyze Request and Design Welcome Loader App
steps.description: Analyze requirements for building a dedicated, clean, single-screen experience focused purely on an interactive welcome sequence with simulated background loaders.

steps.title: Create Project Metadata file
steps.description: Produce app-meta.json detailing 'Welcome Loader' and 'com.welcomeloader.app' to control downstream deployment naming consistently.

steps.title: Configure Build Settings for Gradle 8.5 & AGP 8.3.2
steps.description: Establish target and compile SDK versions to 34, and minimize source compatibility to strictly Java 8 specs.

steps.title: Establish Android Application Manifest
steps.description: Configure AndroidManifest.xml referencing custom launcher styles, package structures, and the native Material Light theme without Action Bar.

steps.title: Create String Resources
steps.description: Create strings.xml holding simple clean display parameters used by the application.

steps.title: Create Welcome Card Style Drawable
steps.description: Draw custom rounded rectangle card_background.xml inside drawables to host loading widgets beautifully.

steps.title: Create Styled Interactive Button Drawable
steps.description: Create modern colored gradient styling file button_background.xml for secondary app reloading operations.

steps.title: Create Circle Avatar Backdrop
steps.description: Prepare circle_background.xml defining circular container space displaying central responsive emojis.

steps.title: Design Welcome Loader UI Layout
steps.description: Create elegant activity_main.xml containing centered container card, standard system circular loader, dynamic status string outputs, and responsive reset actions.

steps.title: Implement MainActivity State Control Flow
steps.description: Implement MainActivity.java executing safe Android handlers displaying sequential loading messages, showing system progress bar, transitioning UI into final welcoming text with active trigger states.

steps.title: Building Welcome Loader
steps.description: Run standard local tests, verify resource assets dependencies, complete final artifact compile debug checks.
